preconditions: frontier F is finite or finitely constructible and deterministically enumerable
underlying respondent incidence or information-equivalent exact contingency is replayable
query engine and validation semantics are pinned
coverage_pass_rule: PASS iff every candidate in F has an exact terminal coverage disposition produced by direct evaluation or by a separately accepted mathematically equivalent/safe theorem that preserves the same candidate-specific semantics. Skipping a candidate for cost, score, proposal order, top-k, beam width, or absent unary signal is incompatible with COMPLETE_FOR_EXACT_DECLARED_FRONTIER.

hostile_oracles.fixture: two lawful binary conditioners A,B with zero unary association and deterministic A XOR B target
hostile_oracles.frontier_condition: interaction family includes A AND B at K>=2
hostile_oracles.required: A×B candidate is evaluated despite zero unary signal and can be selected if validation passes
hostile_oracles.failure: any unary-signal prerequisite or primary-star-only search

hostile_oracles.fixture: pooled direction reverses after conditioning on lawful stratum S
hostile_oracles.frontier_condition: conditional-reversal family includes pooled and S-conditioned facts
hostile_oracles.required: compare exact pooled and conditioned EmpiricalFacts under compatible risk-set/measure semantics; emit reversal only if comparable
hostile_oracles.failure: scalar association score alone or mismatched denominators

hostile_oracles.fixture: supported third/non-top coordinate value has distinctive target distribution
hostile_oracles.required: candidate remains reachable and is not removed by top-two/top-k prevalence truncation

hostile_oracles.fixture: lawful child fork appears only inside a parent branch predicate
hostile_oracles.required: replay parent branch membership, build full branch-local authorized frontier, evaluate under same complete-for-frontier law
hostile_oracles.failure: only majority-deviation path or only globally strong predictors considered

hostile_oracles.fixture: higher-order parity with zero lower-order signal
hostile_oracles.frontier_condition: claimed family and K/J explicitly include required arity
hostile_oracles.required: candidate reachable without lower-order signal prerequisite
hostile_oracles.failure: greedy positive-gain descent used while retaining higher-order completeness claim

hostile_oracles.fixture: same-respondent pair or branch-conditioned response relation
hostile_oracles.required: exact pair/J-way contingency and exact branch membership when conditioned; no modal-cell-only substitute
hostile_oracles.failure: E3 cloud row or E4 score treated as source fact

hostile_oracles.fixture: same unordered frontier supplied in different file/question/input order
hostile_oracles.required: identical candidate identities, coverage dispositions, and winning results
hostile_oracles.failure: processing-order lower triangle, first-row duplicate semantics, or unstable tie order

valid_empty_semantics.meaning: no candidate in the exact declared frontier survives the declared validation/admission law
